title: Move a visit more than 24 hours out
opening: I have a tech coming Thursday but something came up. Can I move it?
callerBrief: You are Linda Foster, phone 512-555-0101, at 4412 Oak Hollow Dr, Round Rock. You have a visit Thursday 2026-10-22, 8 to 12. Give your name and phone when asked. You want to move it to Friday 2026-10-23 in the afternoon, and you take the first Friday afternoon window offered. Then say that covers it. Today is Friday 2026-10-16, about noon.

facts: There is no fee, because the visit is more than 24 hours away
The visit is moved to Friday 2026-10-23 in an afternoon window, with the new date, window and technician read back

dbChange.detail: Appointment 159 moves in place from slot 159 (2026-10-22 08:00-12:00, Marta Kowalski), which becomes open, to slot 193 (2026-10-23 12:00-16:00, Marta Kowalski) or slot 179 (2026-10-23 13:00-17:00, Ray Mendoza), which becomes booked. No appointment is added.
